subject: Head teacher's farewell evening
body:
Dear events team,

Our head teacher retires this summer. We'd like a farewell evening for about 120 staff, governors and former pupils. Supper, then the chair of governors will say a few words.

Kind regards,
Helen

subject: Retirement do for Jean
body:
Hi,

Jean is retiring after 32 years in accounts and we want to give her a proper send-off. About 80 colleagues, some food, and her manager wants to say a few words.

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Leaving do for Tom
body:
Hello,

Tom is off to Australia after nine years with us. We'd like a leaving do for around 60 of the team on a Friday after work. Food and drinks, and a couple of short speeches.

Sam

subject: Farewell party for a senior partner
body:
Hi,

Farewell party for one of our senior partners, 45 people from the firm. Something to eat, wine, and a speech from the managing partner.

Oliver

subject: Sister Margaret's retirement
body:
Hello,

Sister Margaret is retiring after 40 years on the ward. We'd like an evening for around 70 nurses and doctors, a meal of some kind, and the matron will give a short tribute. A couple of retired colleagues use walking sticks.

Anita

subject: Company 10th anniversary dinner
body:
Hi,

We're turning ten! Anniversary dinner for 80 staff, three courses, and our CEO will give a speech.

Grace
